title: Nonparametric Instrumental Kernel Regression: The Well- and Misspecified Setting Under General Link Conditions
abstract: arXiv:2611.21391v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study nonparametric instrumental variable regression when the outcome takes values in a separable Hilbert space $\mathbb{Y}$, for instance a curve, a density or the kernel mean embedding of a distribution. The structural function solves an ill-posed operator equation whose conditional expectation operator need not be injective, and whose solutions need not belong to the hypothesis space. We analyse a two-stage kernel estimator that extends kernel instrumental variable regression to $\mathbb{Y}$-valued outcomes and allows spectral regularisation in both stages, including Landweber iteration and Showalter's method in the second stage. We show that the second stage is a regularisation method in the Hilbert scale generated by the inverse of the kernel integral operator. This viewpoint identifies the solution towards which the estimator converges: the minimum-norm solution in the reproducing kernel Hilbert space in the well-specified cas

translated_title: 非参数工具变量核回归：一般链接条件下的良定与误定情形
translated_abstract: 我们研究结果变量取值于可分希尔伯特空间 $\mathbb{Y}$ 的非参数工具变量回归问题，结果变量例如可以是曲线、密度或分布的核均值嵌入。结构函数求解一个不适定的算子方程，其条件期望算子不必是单射的，其解也不必属于假设空间。我们分析了一种两阶段核估计量，该估计量将核工具变量回归扩展到取值为 $\mathbb{Y}$ 的结果变量，并允许在两个阶段中使用谱正则化方法，包括第二阶段中的 Landweber 迭代和 Showalter 方法。我们证明第二阶段是在由核积分算子的逆所生成的希尔伯特尺度中的一种正则化方法。这一视角明确了估计量收敛的目标：在良定情形下，该目标是再生核希尔伯特空间中的最小范数解（原文摘要在此处不完整）。
tldr: 本文将核工具变量回归推广到取值为希尔伯特空间元素（如曲线、密度、核均值嵌入）的结果变量，并证明其两阶段谱正则化估计量是在核积分算子生成的希尔伯特尺度上的正则化方法，从而在良定与误定情形下刻画了估计量收敛的目标解。
en_tdlr: This paper extends kernel instrumental variable regression to Hilbert-space-valued outcomes and shows that its two-stage spectrally regularised estimator acts as a regularisation method in the Hilbert scale, characterising the solution towards which the estimator converges in both well-specified and misspecified settings.
